{{Quote|Are you sure your ship is intact? This sector has frequent meteor activity!''"<br />"''It's in orbit, protected by a magnetogravitic shield!|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Reynar]]|<ref name="Deadly" />}}
The '''Antolus system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Sarka sector/Legends|Sarka sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> Its dying [[Star/Legends|star]] was orbited by a sole [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Antolus I]]. The Antolus system laid in a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] with frequent meteor activity, meaning that [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in the area required a [[magnetogravitic shield]] in order to stay intact.<ref name="Deadly" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Antolus system first appeared, albeit unnamed, in "[[Deadly Allies]]," a [[Star Wars comic books|comic story]] in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.51|fifty-first issue of the sixth volume]] of the [[Star Wars Comic|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic]] magazine, which [[Titan Magazines]] published<ref name="Deadly">{{TCWComicCite|6.51|Deadly Allies}}</ref> around [[September 19]], [[2013]].<ref name="Date">[[Star Wars Comic|''Star Wars'' Comic]] was published every four weeks, and the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.21|twenty-first issue of the sixth volume]] was published on [[June 2]], [[2011]] according to {{SWArchive|url=vault/books/whatsnew_may27/index.html|text=What's New This Week: ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic'' #6.21}}. Therefore, the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.51|fifty-first issue of the sixth volume]] must have been published on approximately [[September 19]], [[2013]].</ref> The story was written by [[Mike W. Barr]] and illustrated by [[Andres Ponce]].<ref name="Deadly" /> It was later identified as the "Antolus system" in an update by [[July 1]], [[2015]] for the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]], an online companion posted on StarWars.com<ref name="Atlas">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|oldversion=20150701052110}}</ref> written by [[Jason Fry]]<ref name="Fry">{{SW|url=news/the-further-adventures-of-star-wars-the-essential-atlas|text=The Further Adventures of ''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas''|author=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2015-06-29}}</ref> to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. The online companion placed the Antolus system in grid square Q-8.<ref name="Atlas">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|oldversion=20150701052110}}</ref>
